description: Source code for the MediaAppender class in Android's stagefright media framework, handling media appending and muxing operations.

classes.name: MediaAppender
classes.description: Handles media appending, extraction, and muxing operations within Android's media framework.

classes.name: sampleDataInfo
classes.description: Struct holding sample data information such as size, timestamp, track index, and metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a MediaAppender instance with a file descriptor and mode.

methods.description: Starts the muxing process, writing samples to the output.
